_comment: Per-language Door43 target config for the translate pipeline. Verified 2026-07-13: org/repo naming is NOT derivable from the language code (ar lives in org 'BSOJ' not 'ar_gl'). Precedence for each field: per-call options > this file > derivation ({lang}_gl org, {lang}_{resource} repo, unfoldingWord/en_{resource}@master source). Per resourceType: tnRepo/tqRepo/twRepo/taRepo name the target repos; {tn,tq,tw,ta}SourceRef optionally override the SOURCE ref for that resource (org/repo@ref). SOURCE LANGUAGE is a first-class parameter: set sourceLang (default 'en') plus a matching {rt}SourceRef to translate FROM a non-English gateway language (e.g. Russian->Georgian: sourceLang 'ru', tnSourceRef 'ru_gl/ru_tn@master'). contextRef is intentionally omitted (no translation-context repo exists yet); pass it per-call until one is created.

ar.note: BSOJ = Arabic partner. All four repos exist (verified 2026-07-13, master, non-empty). ar_tn holds the partner's English copy of tN (row IDs identical to unfoldingWord/en_tn) -> translate TN in place from BSOJ/ar_tn. TQ/TW/TA source from unfoldingWord/en_* (the pilot default) since the pilot builds fresh gateway drafts; switch to in-place by adding tqSourceRef/twSourceRef/taSourceRef here once the partner content is confirmed.

id.note: Matches the {lang}_gl / {lang}_{resource} convention; standard whole-book / standard article layout. All resources source from unfoldingWord/en_* by default.
